records.short_description: Navy command at Little Creek integrating autonomous air, surface and undersea systems through operational testing, doctrine and training; full capability is still developing.
records.overview: Established September 24, 2026 at Joint Expeditionary Base Little Creek-Fort Story under U.S. Fleet Forces Command. RASWDC coordinates operational integration, testing, doctrine and tactical instruction across autonomous air, surface and undersea systems. Its phased implementation is progressing toward full operational capability. The separate DRPM RAS portfolio handles acquisition.
records.unmanned_systems_relevance: A documented Fleet-facing integration and training command for robotic and autonomous systems, rather than a confirmed commercial testing service.
records.current_activity: The Navy has established RASWDC and is developing its command structure, mission relationships and resources through a phased implementation plan.
records.partnership_opportunities: The establishment release directs information and media queries to Fleet Forces. It does not document commercial-testing intake, fees, availability, permissions or test boundaries.
